<!-- Generated by migration/generators/kind-reference.mjs from the provider's examples and Vulnetix/config-schemas. Edit the generator, not this page. -->
The `vulnetix/resolve` provider has 57 resources, one for each kind the engine stores that the provider's `main` branch has generated. Each is one `vulnetix.com/v1` document of its kind; its arguments are the kind's `spec` in snake case, beside `name`, `labels` and `annotations` from `metadata`. A kind's page has the resource's **Minimal** and **Advanced** HCL beside the YAML and CLI forms, the fields, and how apply treats it. For install, authentication, state and secrets, see [Terraform and OpenTofu](/platform-iac/terraform/).

Import takes the object's name (`metadata.name`); a kind with one object per tenant is named `default`. A secret is a write-only `<name>_wo` argument with a `<name>_wo_version` number.
